analysis.reasonEn: Wait-and-see stance maintained for 3 consecutive sessions after prior buy signal. RSI has exited oversold but remains in neutral range consolidation. ADX at 9.7 signifies a non-trending phase, and volume ratio of 0.82 (below 5-day average) suggests low directional conviction. Price consolidates at 76.2% of 52-week high.
